capabilities: warn on quit when the Git working tree has uncommitted changes
check working tree cleanliness on demand via a command
preview the warning without closing Obsidian
extras: Author states no support, no planned updates or fixes, and that issues and contributions are not accepted; runs the git executable locally, reads .git data possibly outside the vault, and makes no network requests. Mobile is not supported.
problem: Obsidian closes silently even when the vault's Git repository has uncommitted changes, so unsaved work can slip past without being committed.
summary: Quit-time Git guard that shows a large warning when the vault's repository has uncommitted changes as Obsidian closes.
